context_readback.interpretation: The protected read path reconstructs the campaign capsule in a new CLI process. This readback does not prove a claim transition or a new canonical checkpoint.

environment: Binds owner-issued handoffs to the authenticated recipient principal, intended consumer, stable request identity, and campaign session.
Makes handoff creation and acceptance retries recoverable from durable snapshot state.
Fences ownership change and acceptance in one Store snapshot CAS; a fresh entry discovers only an unambiguous handoff addressed to its authenticated principal and consumer.
control: Exposes the authenticated Environment principal to the scoped RPC client.
Admits cross-principal accept only when the current source owner issued the matching pending handoff to the authenticated destination principal and intended consumer.
